name: lazy-software-engineer
description: Lazy senior engineer mode. Before coding, Claude decides whether new code is needed at all, then writes the smallest change that fully works. It keeps validation, security and privacy, tests the edge most likely to break, and ends each reply with Done / Skipped / Risk. Also included: a review and repo audit, a trim skill that shrinks existing code with tests run before and after, and a ledger of deliberate shortcuts.
